Commit: f7673a9f46320ac958878c19f7686e203376ad9d
Local source: /hpc/dctrl/ks723/cmmd (used by Slurm_scripts/cmmd.sh)

The distance.py, embedding.py, io_util.py, and LICENSE files are copied
byte-for-byte from the existing checkout. No metric, preprocessing, or
batching code has been rewritten. The package __init__.py files only allow
normal Python imports from this repository.

The io_util.py docstring mentions dropping the remainder, but the actual
PyTorch DataLoader does not set drop_last=True and includes every image.
